title: Paystride Save Withdrawal Terms
content:
## Withdrawal clauses

**W1.** A withdrawal is booked only while the savings account status is open.

**W2.** A withdrawal goes to the linked Paystride card, instantly when the tier makes withdrawals to the card instant, or to an outside bank account only on tiers that allow outside-bank withdrawals, arriving in the tier's number of business days for an outside-bank withdrawal.

**W3.** At most the tier's number of withdrawals per month are allowed in a calendar month, and at most the tier's daily withdrawal limit a day.

**W4.** A withdrawal never exceeds the balance and costs the tier's withdrawal fee.

**W5.** A frozen account allows no withdrawal.

## Counting the month's withdrawals

The monthly allowance in W3 is counted over the calendar month in which the withdrawal falls, with the withdrawal in question included in the count. A withdrawal is therefore within the allowance when, counting itself, the number of withdrawals in that calendar month does not exceed the tier's figure.

Worked on a hypothetical tier allowance of 6 withdrawals a month:

| Withdrawals already booked in the calendar month | Count including the one requested | Within the monthly allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 5 | Yes |
| 5 | 6 | Yes |
| 6 | 7 | No |

A withdrawal in a new calendar month starts a new count.

## Destination and status at a glance

| Account status | To the linked Paystride card | To an outside bank account |
|---|---|---|
| open | permitted within W3 and W4 | permitted within W3 and W4 only on a tier that allows outside-bank withdrawals |
| frozen | no withdrawal | no withdrawal |
| pending or closed | not booked | not booked |

## Tier figures this policy reads

The monthly allowance and whether outside-bank withdrawals are allowed are tier figures of Paystride Save: 6 a month with no outside-bank withdrawals on Paystride Save Starter, Builder and Boost, and 10 a month with outside-bank withdrawals allowed on Paystride Save Growth, Premier and Elite.

### Hypothetical case

A Paystride Save holder with a balance of $80.00 asks to withdraw $100.00. W4 bars it: a withdrawal never exceeds the balance.
